mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending economic weakness, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% and 0.3% respectively over the past month indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% and RSAFS declines > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY, FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a 0.25 percentage point increase in the federal funds rate within the past month signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month and the economy is in late-cycle expansion (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY, FEDFUNDS > 4.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% over the past month signals a contraction in the manufacturing and industrial sector, which reduces corporate earnings prospects and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1350.0 thousand units in the prior month indicates a significant slowdown in the residential construction sector, which is a leading indicator of weak consumer demand and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1350.0 thousand units in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index exceeding 0.5 percentage points over the past three months signals persistent inflation, which leads to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.8%) and weak job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% over the past month) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.8% and PAYEMS growth < 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.8% and PAYEMS growth is below 0.2% over the prior month.
